method.name: Load_1
method.description: Changes the Offset on the current Curve.

method.name: Load_2
method.description: Changes the Offset Curve on the current Curve.

method.name: NbIntervals
method.description: If necessary, breaks the curve in intervals of continuity <S>. And returns the number of intervals.

method.name: Value
method.description: Computes the point of parameter U on the curve.

method.name: D0
method.description: Computes the point of parameter U on the curve.

method.name: D1
method.description: Computes the point of parameter U on the curve with its first derivative. Raised if the continuity of the current interval is not C1.

method.name: D2
method.description: Returns the point P of parameter U, the first and second derivatives V1 and V2. Raised if the continuity of the current interval is not C2.

method.name: D3
method.description: Returns the point P of parameter U, the first, the second and the third derivative. Raised if the continuity of the current interval is not C3.

method.name: DN
method.description: The returned vector gives the value of the derivative for the order of derivation N. Raised if the continuity of the current interval is not CN. Raised if N < 1.

method.name: Resolution
method.description: Returns the parametric resolution corresponding to the real space resolution <R3d>.

method.name: GetType
method.description: Returns the type of the curve in the current interval: Line, Circle, Ellipse, Hyperbola, Parabola, BezierCurve, BSplineCurve, OtherCurve.
